description:
Migrate the Keller-Gehrig dispatch threshold and the interpolation crossover to runtime resolved reads.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §2 fixes the two field kinds and the mechanism rule with four structural read-pattern obligations, §3 gives every field its name, range, default-naming constant, read site and mechanism, §4 names the route reporter and test obligation per family, and §5.3 states the ratified amortisation screening rule and the behaviour-preservation argument (defaults name the in-source constants; observable behaviour unchanged when no profile is installed). Design §3.9, §3.10 and the charpoly and polynomial rows of §4.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: keller_gehrig_min_dim and interpolate_fast_min_points are runtime resolved reads at their three sites, satisfying design §2.3; both usize endpoints stay admissible with no sentinel reserved.
- [hard] REQ-02: charpoly_route and interpolate_route reporters called by the dispatchers pass their route files, including a Keller-Gehrig-enabled arm asserting result equality with the cubic arm.
- [hard] REQ-03: The dispatch-table rustdoc sweeps in the interpolation and poly modules name the profile fields; existing tests pass unchanged.
title: Cut the charpoly and interpolation selectors over to the tuning profile
